data.name: Saccharine
data.detailed_description:
Ever have one of those holidays?

Former police officer and private detective Sanya K. Vaffelzscki just wants to spend the holidays with her comrades out west. Some turkey and eggnog. Not a lot to ask, right?

Unfortunately, some festive terrorists have their own holiday plans.

A cult lead by God's Greatest Gift has taken over the frozen northern reaches of the Republic of Aysburg, and are hijacking all communications - TV, cellular, even parts of the internet - to spread their idea of holiday cheer.

Fortunately for Sanya, she's proficient in most firearms, and has an undying flame in her heart - to eat turkey with her friends at Christmastime, or die trying!

Saccharine is a violent over the top romp through the holidays.

Cool Features!

  • Eight weapons to kick festive butt with. The candy cane shiv and your 9mm pistol are just the beginning - get the huge four gauge (or is it four guage?) shotgun, a "less lethal" foam dart gun, explosive Christmas crackers, missile-toe launchers, and BB guns. Lay waste to the holly jolly eviltons!

  • Six sizeable levels. Start at an abandoned truck stop and make your way to the northwest through the city streets and malls, and the snowy tundras of the true north.

  • A plethora of evil enemies! Not-so cuddly living teddy bears with shotguns, brainwashed elves with candy cane guns, possessed reindeer that glow so bright, demonic wreaths... and the dreaded cheese police, just to name a few.

  • Hand drawn Flash sprites and pixelated textures make for a neat aesthetic reminiscent of flash animations from the 90s and 2000s.

  • Funny gags and references hidden throughout.

From the creators of Project Absentia, Saccharine is a tasty throwback of the violent sort to Christmas specials of days gone by.

data.short_description: From the creators of Project Absentia, Saccharine is a tasty FPS throwback of the violent sort to Christmas specials of days gone by. Play as Sanya Vaffelzscki as she kicks terrorist ass and tries to visit her friends out west.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/Windows 11 (64-bit Only)
  • Processor: 2.4GHz Multi-Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL or Vulkan Dedicated Graphics Card with 4GB of VRAM
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard sound
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system, and non-potato hardware
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/Windows 11 (64-bit Only)
  • Processor: Intel i5, Ryzen 5 or above
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL or Vulkan Dedicated Graphics Card with 8GB of VRAM
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard sound
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system, and non-potato hardware

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains satirical subject matters in a fictional yet cartoony world.

It also contains wanton and gratuitous violence and vulgar language.

Player/viewer discretion is advised.
